name: normal-role-composite
description: Thirteen fresh normal-mode games, one for every role, with legal race, gender, and alignment combinations. Each fixed-seed trace keeps the default pet and autopickup behavior and composes initial inventory, status and discovery windows, counted searches, waits, movement, ordinary map generation, monster scheduling, timers, hunger, regeneration, and prompt paging.
